entities.summary: Ibn al‐Bannāʾ al‐Marrākushī, full name: Abu'l-Abbas Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Uthman al-Azdi al-Marrakushi, was a Arab polymath who was active as a mathematician, astronomer, Islamic scholar, Sufi and astrologer.
